findings.text: writes each arm's solver-terminal state under the seed-named npz keys (states["analytic_seed" if policy == "analytic" else "disc_seed"] = state, saved at :673 with the case's analytic state as the separate analytic key), a line unchanged at the revisions that wrote both archives (:416 at fc662f6cf, :615 at 83f40323a); the archives prove the names do not match their contents: in docs/figures/plasma-cell-read-fidelity-seed/diverted-single-null-seed-policy.npz the key analytic hashes to 6215c9f34c86f29e... which is the analytic arm's recorded seed_state_digest, while analytic_seed (ffb059b39398041d...) and disc_seed (08d1516eda3dc4dc...) match no seed digest in the receipt nor its rebuild digests, and weak-rotation-reactor-static-seed-policy.npz repeats it (disc_seed c2ee3402fc74b32c..., not the arm's cb2b3c7bfde723f7...), so a reader recovering a policy seed from an archive by key name gets a solved terminal state.

states the reactor-static arms were produced at fed676eec, but the job the same section credits with them (1276643) ran 13:33:01 to 13:53:51 on 2026-09-23 and ended 41 minutes before fed676eec was committed at 14:15:42, and betelgeuse-control-1276643.log carries no revision line, so the record names a revision the arms cannot have been measured at while the module revision at that job's launch (83f40323a, committed 13:32:40) appears neither in the record nor in the receipt.

credits job 1276643 with the diverted control, while the receipt's control rows carry one_trip_residual 0.26431137975177044 (six occurrences, the reading of job 1276711 in betelgeuse-ranges-1276711.log) and zero occurrences of 1276643's own control reading 0.26431131347736286, so the log the record names for the control does not reproduce the receipt's control numbers (the two runs agree to 2.5e-7 relative, so this is a provenance defect rather than a disagreement about the value).

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 22acdbadad8b; nine commits, insertions only, build the driver with its receipt, figure pair and state archives, add no test file, and the module is ruff check and format clean at head. The controls are live rather than decorative (the one-trip control's refusal and trip count are asserted, the contour positive control is asserted, every arm records non-finite moment counters), and the three defects this review records are record and archive defects rather than solve defects.
item_verdicts.done_when: the measurement, the receipt, the figure, the control and the record are all delivered, and the done-when's one-job clause is carried by three jobs: 1276595 wrote the diverted arms and failed inside its control after 12m21s; 1276643 completed 0:0 in 00:20:50 producing the reactor-static arms (betelgeuse-control-1276643.log); 1276711 completed 0:0 in 00:07:17 producing the seed flux ranges for both cases, the control rows the receipt carries and the completion (betelgeuse-ranges-1276711.log). The assembly is disclosed by the manifest's earlier_job line and by the landed record, so the clause is met by accumulated jobs rather than by the single logged job it names.
item_verdicts.goal: benchmarks/plasma_cell_seed_policy.py:64-71 fixes the two cases, the 110-cell reduced rung spelled -110, the analytic and current-centroid disc policies and the route's own production seed, and docs/figures/plasma-cell-read-fidelity-seed/seed-policy-at-main.json records both_fail. The receipt supports the accepted claim that seed amplitude separates the seeds without ordering the failure: diverted amplitudes 0.0161653, 0.0240336 and 0.0762040 Wb at ratios 1.0, 1.4867 and 4.7140 to the analytic range, where the closest-amplitude analytic seed fails on residual (0.264311358287, its X-point 0.0219216 m inside the 0.1514 m bound) while the disc seed fails on position (1.0768831 m); reactor-static amplitudes 69.320746 and 179.968806 Wb at 1.0 and 2.5962, the lower-amplitude arm carrying the lower residual (0.047076170327 against 0.075008275087). Two qualifications, both disclosed: on reactor-static the disc policy seed and the production seed are one state (identical digests and endpoints), and the ranges table's disc entry is the rebuilt seed, whose bit digest differs from the measured arm's while its amplitude matches at 8.88e-16 relative.
item_verdicts.manifest: read in full; it records status complete, the gate (job 1276711, exit 0:0, 00:07:17, with log and negative_control_log paths, and the earlier_job line), the seven-job history including three FAILED and two cancelled attempts, and a changed_paths list matching the commit stat exactly. I re-read the receipt and both job logs against it and the arm residuals, seeds, bounds, digests and non-finite counters all read as recorded; its earlier_job line repeats the control-attribution slip that the finding on the landed record's :263 records.
item_verdicts.write_paths: every file in base 22acdbadad8b..head 9988d625 lies inside the declared write paths (git diff --shortstat reads 6 files changed, 39074 insertions(+), 0 deletions: the 951-line module, the receipt with its two npz archives, the PNG/SVG pair), and the plan and landed-record edits were applied to the canonical checkout and committed on main (edbd943f7, a96e3e949) as the manifest's plan_and_record states, so no live plan state regressed and no path left the declared set.

justifications.durability: the module's guards are asserted rather than decorative (the forced one-trip control's refusal and its trip_count==1 at benchmarks/plasma_cell_seed_policy.py:843, the seed-rebuild identity and amplitude asserts at :721 and :742, the contour positive control at :495, the x64 and GPU asserts at :759-760 and :864-865, and per-arm non-finite moment counters); the deductions are that no committed test covers the module (none of the six changed paths is under tests/) and that the construction-identity assertion is vacuous where the recorded seed_receipt carries no construction fields (construction_fields_checked is [] on both analytic rows in seed_rebuilds), so for those arms only the 1e-6 amplitude tolerance and a digest recorded rather than asserted stand before a changed seed.
justifications.evidence: the receipt's provenance is honest where stated (slurm_job_id 1276595 and completion_job_id 1276711 name their jobs, every non-reproduction is recorded per entry with its expected_source at benchmarks/plasma_cell_seed_policy.py:814-859, and I reproduced the arms, bounds, digests and control values from the two job logs); the deductions are that the landed record credits the receipt's control rows to job 1276643 (docs/evidence/archive/plasma-cell-read-fidelity-landed.html:263) and names fed676eec for reactor-static arms measured before that commit existed (:264), and that the done-when's single-job clause became three jobs.
justifications.fit: the module follows the repository benchmark idiom (argparse subcommands, receipt written beside its figure, ruff check and format clean at head, no plan or ticket label in code, comments or names) and docs/figures/plasma-cell-read-fidelity-seed/seed-policy-at-main.png obeys the plotting mandate through nova.media (axes off, unfilled contours on one shared physical level array per case with its SVG companion, wall units drawn, both null sets marked).
justifications.goal_fidelity: benchmarks/plasma_cell_seed_policy.py:64-71 pins the cases, rung, policies and production seed, and docs/figures/plasma-cell-read-fidelity-seed/seed-policy-at-main.json records both_fail with the amplitudes 0.0161653/0.0240336/0.0762040 Wb at 1.0/1.4867/4.7140 and 69.320746/179.968806 at 1.0/2.5962, which supports the claim that amplitude separates the seeds without ordering the failure; the deduction is that the answer rests one derivation away from the measured arms, the ranges table reporting the rebuilt disc seed's bit state (digest_matches false in seed_rebuilds) and the plan paragraph at docs/plans/plasma-cell-read-fidelity.html:235 quoting the receipt without that rebuild note.
justifications.scope_discipline: every committed path lies inside the declared write paths (git diff --shortstat over 22acdbadad8b..9988d625 reads 6 files changed, 39074 insertions(+), 0 deletions) and the plan and landed record were edited in the canonical checkout and committed on main rather than in the worktree, so the change cannot regress live plan state; the one open point is that the manifest notes the two main-checkout commits are unpushed and leaves them to the coordinator.
